question: What inbound QQBot gateway message limit should OpenClaw enforce while preserving legitimate delivery?
rationale: The patch correctly narrows ws's 100 MiB default, but selecting 1 MiB trades memory-exhaustion resistance against an undocumented platform compatibility boundary that automation cannot safely choose.

options.title: Use a 16 MiB cap
options.body: Rebase while preserving handshakeTimeout and use the established conservative gateway precedent unless stronger QQ-specific size evidence becomes available.

options.title: Approve the 1 MiB cap
options.body: Keep the tighter limit only with QQBot owner acceptance of the delivery risk and preferably authenticated production-size or telemetry evidence.

options.title: Pause for platform evidence
options.body: Leave the PR open until Tencent documents a maximum or representative production events establish a defensible threshold.

recommendation.title: Use a 16 MiB cap
recommendation.body: Rebase while preserving handshakeTimeout and use the established conservative gateway precedent unless stronger QQ-specific size evidence becomes available.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository's contributor ownership guidance explicitly associates Sliverp with the QQ channel area, so they are the best available decision-routing candidate.
